name: io.github.wonderben-code/oip
title: Open Intelligence Protocol
description: Gives an assistant a mind on the Open Intelligence Protocol: find, message, offer and commit.

environmentVariables.name: OIP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The directory of the mind, made with `oip init`. Default: ~/.oip

environmentVariables.name: OIP_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: The passphrase of the mind's keys. Not needed for a mind made with `oip init --keychain`.
